language.name: Catalan
language.canonical_note: One canonical lang:cat course serves Andorra, Spain, and France; standards acknowledge major territorial varieties.

orthography_pronunciation.voice_strategy: Synthetic ca-ES browser voice with explicit provenance; regional pronunciation is taught rather than labelled erroneous.

CEFR_progression.A1: sound-spelling, identity, agreement, present and basic articles
CEFR_progression.A2: past narration, weak pronouns, quantities, requests and plans
CEFR_progression.B1: connected narration, relative clauses, subjunctive and explanation
CEFR_progression.B2: complex conditions, passive/impersonal forms, focus and register
CEFR_progression.C1: academic synthesis, mediation and calibrated stance
CEFR_progression.C2: scope, implication, rhetoric, idiom, genre transformation and stylistic precision

sources.title: Gramàtica essencial de la llengua catalana
sources.use: authoritative phonology, morphology, syntax and usage

sources.title: Ortografia catalana
sources.use: normative spelling, accents, apostrophes, diaeresis and compounds
